note: Each record is the highest rung of the 8004 sieve one ERC-8004 agent reached when ARP last walked it: 0 shell, 1 described, 2 declares an address, 3 answers, 4 speaks, 5 used. Each rung is one request anyone can repeat (/docs/the-sieve). could_not_say means a failure that is not a verdict left the agent at the rung below. It is a fact per step, not a grade.
